latest_notes: Fork of pcxgg/PackMerger. 1.4.2: a removed datapack's resource pack is no longer sent forever, no false 'corrupt zip' warning while a datapack is uploaded, /pm scan always reports a fresh scan, pack folders can be renamed on Windows while the server runs, new upload.self-host.bind. Since 1.4.0 the update check reads GitHub releases; this file is only used by a custom update-check.url.
